localizedValues.name: Shelter
localizedValues.description:
The Picnic shelter is a log structure with a tin roof and concrete floor. It is situated in a large grassy day use area approximately 100m from Ten Mile Lake. The lake view is restricted by a stand of mature trees. The day use area is equipped with two change houses and playground for children.
Liquor can only be consumed on registered campsites by legal adults. Drinking alcohol is prohibited in all day-use and public frontcountry areas, including campground washrooms and roadways.

localizedValues.description: Site is located next to the washroom with minimal visual privacy.
